sysevent_email_action.message_html:
<table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="background-color:#f4f4f4;padding:20px 0;">
  <tr>
    <td align="center">
      <table width="600" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="background-color:#ffffff;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;">
        <tr>
          <td style="background-color:#1a1a2e;padding:24px 32px;">
            <p style="margin:0;color:#ffffff;font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:1px;">CYBER INCIDENT MANAGEMENT</p>
            <p style="margin:4px 0 0;color:#a0a8c0;font-size:12px;">Restricted — Authorised Personnel Only</p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="padding:32px;">
            <p style="margin:0 0 16px;color:#b00020;font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;line-height:1.6;">
              URGENT — PERSISTENT THREAT ACTIVE
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0 0 16px;color:#1a1a2e;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;">
              A persistent threat actor has been identified as still active within the environment.
              Standard communication channels may be compromised. Treat this notification as out-of-band.
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0 0 8px;color:#1a1a2e;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;">
              <strong>Incident:</strong> ${number}<br>
              <strong>Summary:</strong> ${short_description}<br>
              <strong>Severity:</strong> ${acsc_incident_severity}<br>
              <strong>Threat Category:</strong> ${threat_category}<br>
              <strong>Threat Actor:</strong> ${threat_actor_classification}<br>
              <strong>MITRE ATT&CK Tactic:</strong> ${mitre_att_ck_tactic}
            </p>
            <p style="margin:16px 0 0;color:#b00020;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">
              Initiate out-of-band communication procedures immediately.<br>
              Do not discuss incident details via standard email or chat channels.
            </p>
            <p style="margin:16px 0 0;color:#1a1a2e;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;">
              ${URI_REF}
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td style="background-color:#f4f4f4;padding:16px 32px;border-top:1px solid #e0e0e0;">
            <p style="margin:0;color:#888888;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;">
              This notification was generated by the Cyber Incident Management system.
              <br>Access is restricted to authorised MIM and Cyber Security team personnel.
              <br>Do not forward this email outside of authorised channels.
            </p>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </table>
    </td>
  </tr>
</table>
sysevent_email_action.name: CYB - Persistent Threat Notification
sysevent_email_action.subject: Persitent Threat Alert: ${number} - ${short_description}
